unemployedQuestions.question: What's the Credit Score?
unemployedQuestions.description:
⭐ Understanding Credit Score (CIBIL)
Your Credit Score is a 3-digit number (300-900) that represents your creditworthiness based on your credit history.
300-549Poor
550-649Fair
650-749Good
750-900Excellent
How to check your score?
Visit cibil.com or use apps like Paytm, PhonePe, or your bank's app to get a free credit report.
Note: A score of 750+ increases your chances of loan approval and better interest rates.
